bio: Jeremy Hunt is a visual designer who has worked extensively across the marching arts in drum corps, marching band, and indoor winter guard. In Drum Corps International he has written and instructed for Phantom Regiment, the Cavaliers, Spirit of Atlanta (2010-2012), and the Colts (2007-2009), and his portfolio includes multiple DCI finalist shows alongside numerous BOA championship and WGI medaling productions. He attended Western Kentucky University and resides in Austin, Texas.

John Leonard is a color guard designer and caption supervisor for the Cavaliers, where he is a former marching member. A teacher and choreographer for over 25 years, he has worked with numerous groups including Phantom Regiment (color guard caption head, 2015), Santa Clara Vanguard, and Crossmen, as well as many universities and high schools. He has also served on the North Texas Colorguard Association Executive Board, including as President, and on the WGI steering committee.

José Peña is a color guard performer and choreographer from Palm Desert, California, who began color guard at Palm Desert High School. His marching experience includes Blue Devils A Corps (2012-2014) and Blue Devils International (2015), along with Fantasia Winterguard and other Southern California programs. He taught three years on staff at The Academy and has choreographed for numerous schools and winter guards in Southern California. He holds a BA in Psychology and a Master's in Teaching/Education.

Dr. Joe Busuito is Associate Director of Bands and Director of Athletic Bands at East Carolina University, where he directs the Marching Pirates and pep band and conducts the Symphonic Band. Active in drum corps since 2006, he marched with the Cavaliers in 2006 and 2007 and later served on the brass staff of the Cadets, Santa Clara Vanguard (2012-2015), and the Bluecoats, primarily instructing baritones and euphoniums. He holds a Doctor of Musical Arts in Instrumental Conducting from the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign.
Justin Cohen is a drum corps visual instructor. He served on the Cavaliers' visual educational team in 2019 and has been a member of the Bluecoats' visual staff, including the 2024 and 2025 seasons.

Kathleen Ballard joined the Colts Youth Organization in May 2022 as assistant corps director, leading the summer administrative team in planning and executing the 80-day tour for the DCI World Class corps. In the offseason she handles recruiting, auditions, member relations, and housing. Her background includes school nutrition programs in New Jersey, and she has experience playing and teaching marching cymbals.
